character.appendages: Two attached flexible feelers and one attached tapering tail are the only long appendages. Do not add arms, legs, wings, horns, detached particles or a second tail; feeler and tail direction follows each donor cell.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas 64x64, source origin [23,38], union [-15,-28,33,16]. Preserve the shared origin: low forms contact near the source baseline while upright feelers extend high above it; do not bbox-recenter or per-cell autofit.
character.faceAndExpression: One leading eye and a small mouth change with pose: neutral/closed expressions dominate low cells, while tall and effort cells visibly open the mouth; rear, curled, silhouette and collapsed cells intentionally occlude the face.
character.locomotion: Source cells show low rocking and sliding, horizontal stretch/compression, tight curl/spin, diagonal turn, short lift, tall upright rear and complete collapse. Preserve raw sequence IDs because action names are not proven.
character.morphology: Small low limbless/short-contact juvenile body with a compact rounded head-body, two long attached flexible feelers and one tapering curled tail. It remains ground-hugging except for source-authored vertical lifts, curls and tumbles.
character.restraint: Main 026-042 is the complete restrained block. A gold/dark external binding crosses or wraps low, flat, curled and upright poses; every canonical restrained master and all aliases must retain readable binding.
character.specialStates: Main 043/045 are orange-red color states, 046 tall black silhouette, 047 low black silhouette, 060 stone-gray and 063 white evolution silhouette. Main 044 and 048-059/061-062 are aliases or distinct normal-palette/defeated motion cells, not generic recolors.
